name: Perspective Zoom Effect
description: Scroll-driven landing sequence: a pinned 3D perspective zoom of floating space images around a big title, then a letter-by-letter text reveal, a scrolling marquee and chapter cards.
contents: Pinned hero with large title and 12 floating images on three depth layers
Pinned paragraph that reveals character by character
Chapters section with label, title, intro and three cards
behavior: Images and title fly toward the viewer with CSS perspective while the section is pinned
Characters fade in on scroll, then the paragraph scales up and fades out
Marquee track moves horizontally with scroll
Chapter cards rise in with a stagger when the section enters

props.name: revealText
props.default: Look up long enough and the night sky stops feeling distant and starts feeling like home.

props.name: chaptersIntro
props.default: A short tour of where stars come from, how their light travels, and how much room there is out there.

editableByProps: Title, reveal paragraph, marquee words, chapters text and cards
Images, alt text and depth layer of each image
Scrub smoothness and scroll length of zoom and reveal
Background, text, muted, border and marquee Tailwind color classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change where images sit around the title
Change layer opacity or depth travel
needsCodeEdit.where: LAYER_CLASSES constant and the data-layer tweens in the first timeline

fixed: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger pins for the hero and the text reveal, so it adds scroll length to the page
Image positions are fixed slots that repeat after 12 images
Image size is capped at 300px and slots scale with viewport width, so images are small on phones
